description: A dropdown for selecting a single value from a list of options. Use Select.Combobox for searchable/filterable selection, and Select.Multi or Select.Combobox.Multiple for multi-value selection.
instructions: Use Select for simple single-value selection. Use Select.Combobox when users need to search or filter the options list. Use Select.Multi or Select.Combobox.Multiple for multi-value selection. Group options with Select.Group. Use Select.Slot to add icons to items. Use Dropdown instead when items trigger actions rather than selecting a value. Use indeterminateValues on Select.Multi or Select.Combobox.Multiple when editing several records at once and an option applies to some of them but not all — those options render a dash instead of a checkmark and the trigger gains a '2 mixed' badge next to the selection badges. It is purely visual: indeterminate values are never reported by onSelect, selecting one applies it to every record, and it does not return to the partial state when switched off again.
name: Select
